FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
&
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160 014
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Junior Research Fellow in the DST-
SERB-SURE Research Project entitled “Design and synthesis of new amphiphatic cyclopeptides,
study of their antimicrobial activity and antibiotic synergy” under the joint supervision of Dr. Deepak B.
Salunke, Department of Chemistry (Principal Investigator) and Dr. Rachna Singh (Co-Principal
Investigator), Assistant Professor, Department of Microbial Biotechnology, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
Essential Qualification:
Post Graduate Degree in Chemistry (M.Sc.) (preferably in Organic Chemistry) with qualification in the
National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship or GATE.
Preference will be given to the candidates with research experience in academia, industry or master
research project.
Fellowship:
Monthly emoluments of the fellowship shall be as per DST norms, the duration of the fellowship is for
the period of one year and can be extended further based on the performance of the candidate.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of the Chairperson,
Department of Chemistry, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the office of the undersigned by email
or sent by post latest by November 22, 2023. The date and time of the interview will be informed to
the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview letters will be issued and no TA/DA will be
provided for attending the interview. The position is purely on temporary basis and is coterminous with
the project.
Dr. Deepak B. Salunke
Assistant Professor
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014
salunke@pu.ac.in
